method: Original x86 lookup routines use actual PC tables with name passed in EDI (a custom register ABI missed by initial C pseudocode). GIT 0x59db00 is executed with original action-node output callback0x59e080 and synthetic parent completion flags. No callback replacement or OS API.

contracts.lookup: Case insensitive; game table wins over built-in, first name entry wins; unknown returnsNULL. PreviousResult has a real table entry withNULL handler.
contracts.All: All parent output checks nonzero; true for zero parents.
contracts.Any: At least one parent output nonzero; false for zero parents.
contracts.None: No parent output nonzero; true for zero parents.
contracts.Sum: At least threshold parent outputs nonzero; for zero parents true only for zero threshold. Counts booleans, not magnitudes.
contracts.Exactly: Number of nonzero parent outputs equals threshold.
contracts.Loop: Requires all parent outputs, or totalParents-loopSkip when flag0x400 is set. Successful predicate then propagates/reset-walks children; this side effect excluded by zero-child fixtures.

limits: Parent fixtures use action-node kind2 completion bits; live gizmo callback values and whole graph scheduling not exhaustively emulated.
Loop predicate verified with no children; recursive reset/walk side effects not validated here.
No complete SCP interpreter or execution of gameplay action handlers.
